svg.title: Ancient spiral: four times on the same spatial scale
svg.desc: Numerical Yin–Yang arms, joined through the origin, and an orange corrected grim-reaper cap. The asymptotic model unwinds from t=-24 to -8. These are not computed ancient PDE slices.

g.text: Numerical rotating arms + asymptotic cap · same scale in all panels
Blue arms rotate counterclockwise; the orange cap travels clockwise.
Zhang–Olson–Khan–Angenent, §2 and Appendix A. Asymptotic model, not an exact ancient flow.
